title: Project Ontology is a meaningful executable second domain
claim: The same generic EOO mechanisms can govern the real hypothesis-driven lifecycle of operational-ontology-poc, enforce preregistration/evidence/verdict invariants, and provide at least one operational advantage over file-only discipline without replacing Git as authority.
null_hypothesis: Project Ontology merely mirrors Markdown/JSON and requires equally bespoke validators/actions, adding no operational value beyond conventional repository scripts.
rivals: A small set of JSON schemas plus CI scripts enforces the same lifecycle more simply.
Self-hosting appears valuable only because the baseline is intentionally under-validated.
mechanism: Representing research entities, links, states and governed actions in the shared EOO should allow generic lifecycle enforcement, provenance queries and generated action surfaces already needed by other domains.
scope: Actual H15-H22 artifacts and their lifecycle, not a toy project dataset.
predictions: Illegal transitions such as post-freeze threshold mutation, verdict without evidence and evidence bound to the wrong version are blocked or classified explicitly.
Verdicts are reproducible from frozen evaluator + evidence.
The same generic Engine action pipeline used by Manufacturing executes Project Ontology state changes.
At least one preregistered task class requires less bespoke integrity/tooling code than an equally strong file-only baseline.
Every canonical change remains traceable to Git.
falsifiers: Project lifecycle enforcement requires bespoke runtime branches.
A supported/rejected verdict can be set arbitrarily without evaluator evidence.
Project Ontology cannot prevent or surface a preregistered illegal transition.
The equally strong file-only baseline achieves the same generated/query/action behavior with no greater bespoke change and lower recurring complexity across all measured task classes.

experiment.summary: Dogfood H15-H22 themselves through Project Ontology and compare invariant enforcement/tooling against a strong Git+schema+CI baseline.
steps: Load H15-H22 as real project objects linked to contracts/commits/evidence.
Execute preregistration, freeze, run, attach evidence, derive verdict, supersede through generic Actions.
Build an equally strong file-only baseline with the same invariants.
Measure bespoke code/config touched for lifecycle, forensic queries and one change to the hypothesis model.

oracle: Independent pure lifecycle state machine plus Git history for canonical facts.
baseline: Git + JSON/Markdown + JSON Schema + CI scripts implementing the same declared invariants without the EOO runtime.

support_if: 0 illegal lifecycle transitions accepted across generated corpus.
100% authoritative verdicts reproducible from frozen evidence/evaluator.
0 canonical ontology-only changes lacking Git trace.
At least one preregistered operational task class shows >=25% lower bespoke implementation/change surface than the equally strong file-only baseline with no correctness loss.
reject_if: Any core governance invariant can be bypassed, or all preregistered operational task classes show parity/worse bespoke change surface while EOO adds recurring complexity.
inconclusive_if: The baseline is not implemented to equivalent invariant strength or the task corpus is incomplete.
invalid_if: Project Ontology is allowed to grade its own hypothesis without independent lifecycle oracle/evidence checks.

python_hypothesis_role.strategy: RuleBasedStateMachine generates hypothesis lifecycle operations, stale edits, evidence binding errors, verdict attempts and supersession sequences.
python_hypothesis_role.mutation_proof: Allow post-freeze threshold edit, allow verdict without evidence, and detach commit provenance; each mutation must be found.

stop_conditions: If self-hosting requires Project-specific Engine code, reject/narrow before adding more project features.
